Kuvitus: Maa avaruudesta nähtynä, ympäri: Illustration: the Earth seen from space, with a thin atmosphere around it. The Sun shines at the left edge of the picture, and stars twinkle in the black sky.
Kuvitus: omakotitalo talviyönä. Lämpöä k: Illustration: a detached house on a winter night. Heat escapes outwards through the windows and the roof, shown by orange arrows. There is snow on the ground.
Kolme lämmön siirtymistapaa, periaatekuv: The three ways of heat transfer, schematic diagram. Conduction: heat travels through a metal rod from the hot end to the cold end. Convection: warm water rises in the middle of a pot and cooled water sinks at the edges, so the water circulates. Radiation: a hot object emits radiation, which travels through empty space.
Maapallon energiatasapaino, periaatekuva: Energy balance of the Earth, schematic diagram. Radiation from the Sun passes through the atmosphere to the ground; part of it is reflected back into space. The ground radiates thermal radiation upwards, and the greenhouse gases of the atmosphere radiate part of it back down.
Seinän poikkileikkaus ja lämpötilan kulk: Cross-section of a wall and the course of the temperature, schematic diagram. The wall has a thin inner board, a thick layer of insulation and a thin outer cladding. The temperature falls from 21 degrees indoors to minus 15 degrees outdoors, that is, by 36 kelvins, and most of the fall happens in the insulation. The thermal power P passes through the wall from the inside to the outside.
